page0.text:
I don't need to even think about it.
And shit, even I only have so much patience.
Every single one of them is sure Saber's going to disappear.
Saber won't disappear; I'm going to fight with her until the end.
I can't let this destroy the oath we made.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page0:1

page1.text: "Illya. I can't do what you're asking me to. I have Saber. As long as Saber's around, I'm going to keep on fighting as a Master."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page1:1

page2.text:
"..."
A soft gasp.
For a second, her red eyes snapped open as if she'd just gone into rigor mortis.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page2:1

page3.text:
"Oh... So you're going to betray me too, Shirou."
Illya backs away.
She looks down, but maintains her composure.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page3:1

page4.text:
"Fine. If you're not going to listen to me, I'm not going to listen to you, either.
I've been letting you do whatever you want, but that ends now."
Illya's voice is dripping with hostility now.
There's something terrible lurking behind that malice.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page4:1

page5.text: "Wait right here. I'll just be a minute."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page5:1

page6.text:
"Wait! What are you going to do, Illya!?"
"Oh, nothing... I'm just going to go kill Saber and Rin. If I kill the two of them, that'd make you feel kind of guilty, right?"
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page6:1

page7.text: "Wha...? Don't be ridiculous! Saber and Tohsaka have nothing to do with this! I'm only saying I can't be with you for my own reasons!"
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page7:1

page8.text: "Oh really? Well, I'm still killing them. Once that's over, it'll be your turn. If you won't be mine, you're useless to me."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page8:1

page9.text:
I hear Illya's footsteps moving off.
Illya's serious.
She really means to go kill Saber and Tohsaka.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page9:1

page10.text: "Stop, Illya! Saber and Tohsaka have nothing to do with this! I'm the one you captured, so if you're going to hate someone, just hate me! You don't need to kill them!"
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page10:1

page11.text:
"I have a reason. I can't leave any other Master alive. Isn't that how Holy Grail Wars work?"
"You dummy! Don't talk about killing people like it's so easy! You shouldn't ever do that! You're a kid! You shouldn't even be thinking about this kind of thing!"
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page11:1

page12.text:
Illya stares at me in disbelief.
"Too late. I've already killed a Master, brother."
She sounds so joyful as she says it.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page12:1

page13.text: "Yesterday, though. I thought you were going to take care of him, so I didn't expect to do it."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page13:1

page14.text:
"Wh...at?"
In that instant...
...I, surprisingly, understand exactly what she's talking about.
Illya was in the building last night.
Which means...
...she must have seen the Master, running for his life, as the perfect prey.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page14:1

page15.text:
"Illya...you didn't..."
"Sorry. I only did it because you didn't. I don't actually like taking other people's stuff."
She doesn't sound guilty at all.
It probably meant nothing to her.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page15:1

page16.text:
...
It makes me realize something.
...I've probably known this since the moment we first met.
She really doesn't know the difference between good and evil.
That innocent laugh is just as much Illya as the merciless laugh I hear now.
It's not that Illya has a devil on one shoulder and an angel on the other.
Illya, however angelic she may look, is a devil.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page16:1

page17.text:
"Well, I'm off.
When I get back, it'll be your turn, so do your best to escape."
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page17:1

page18.text:
"Then again, a little bird in captivity will remain in captivity, because it can't escape.
Knowing you, you won't be able to escape this little cage."
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page18:1

page19.text:
Illya leaves.
She is absolutely right of course.
She knows nothing of threats or tactics, so she just...says what's true.
But I can't stay here forever.
I need to escape and meet up with Saber before Illya can attack her.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page19:1

page20.text:
"Ungh...!"
I shake myself, trying to loosen the ropes around my wrists.
Maybe she really doesn't think I can escape. There's no one else here.
If I'm not being watched, even I can manage to get out of some ropes, but...
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page20:1

page21.text:
"Damn...I still can't..."
My body just won't listen to me.
My limbs move, but they're heavy as lead, and just trying to move at all is exhausting.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page21:1

page22.text:
"Illya knew I couldn't escape because of this..."
I can't move like this.
Even if I get out of the rope, I won't be able to escape the room if I can hardly move.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page22:1

page23.text: "My whole body feels heavy not because I'm tired... Yeah, I haven't been able to move since I looked into Illya's eyes."
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page23:1

page24.text:
They must be Mystic Eyes.
I hear truly superior mages can perform some sort of magecraft just by making eye contact with their target.
Restraint is a common effect of Mystic Eyes, so that's probably what's going on here.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page24:1

page25.text:
Eyes are how we take in visual information, and so are susceptible to suggestion and spells.
And that is why most mages employ some sort of protection on their eyes to block out other mages' magecraft.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page25:1

page26.text: "Tohsaka would be so mad if she found out all it took to paralyze me was a suggestion, not even a spell..."
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page26:1

page27.text:
...Well, at least that was from Mystic Eyes learned through magecraft.
Some monsters are born with Mystic Eyes and don't even need to lock eyes with their target.
I hear all they need to do is look to use whatever ability they have, but it's also extremely rare for people to have powers like that.
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page27:1

page28.text:
And...
Luckily, Illya's Mystic Eyes aren't unique or special. They're just a means of sending magical energy at a target.
And that means there has to be a way to dispel the effect.
Illya's magical energy is invading my nerves, preventing me from moving.
If I can get rid of that magical energy, that should fix my paralysis.
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page28:1

page29.text: "It's simple. If there's a buildup of mud, then all I have to do is flush it out to clean it out."
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page29:1

page30.text:
I close my eyes and focus inward, on my own body.
I may not have the skill to detect and remove foreign magical energy that's invaded my body...
But I don't need anything like that, so long as I'm dealing with magical energy that hasn't become a curse and taken root in my body.
If Illya's magical energy is lingering, stagnant in my body, I just need a strong flow of magical energy through my body to flush it out."
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page30:1

page31.text:
"Sorry...it's crude, but it's all I can do."
I apologize to my body for what I'm about to put it through.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page31:1

page32.text:
All I have to do is focus on my daily routine.
The ritual where I force a foreign nerve down my spine.
No, not anymore.
I don't need to build it from scratch anymore.
Now all I have to do is flip the switch in my head.
Instead of creating a Magic Circuit in my body, I just have to switch my nerves into a Magic Circuit.
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page32:1

page33.text:
"Trace, on."
I murmur the spell to focus myself.
You don't use spells to change the world around you.
They're to be used on yourself...to empower you to change the world.
For mages, they're a way to initiate a kind of self-transformation.
Spells are the first, most basic magecraft used to create a Mystic just for you...a command that will only work on you.
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page33:1

page34.text:
"Basic structure...analysis."
My blood flow accelerates.
Power builds in my blood.
My body is becoming a machine for circulating magical energy.
...Probably thanks to the gem Tohsaka made me swallow.
Normally, this would take me at least an hour. Now, I'm able to do it almost instantly.
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page34:1

page35.text:
"Composition...analysis."
I don't even need to flip the switch at this rate.
I can just let the magical energy circulate and let my hands go.
Actually...
I say flip the switch, but I still haven't found the switch to begin with.
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page35:1

page36.text:
Heat rushes into me.
I try to get control over my pounding heart, and my hands slip from the bucking reins.
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page36:1

page37.text:
"Gugh...!"
Blood spurts from my mouth.
I must have opened a vein, or torn something inside myself...
I channeled enough magical energy to flush out the mud that had invaded me, so it's no wonder I'm throwing up blood. Luckily, I don't feel any pain.
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page37:1

page38.text:
"Maybe I'm not in pain because of that self-healing thing I have..."
It's an abnormality of my body that I still don't understand, but I'm delighted to have it at a time like this.
The ability to heal any nonfatal wound is my biggest—and only—strength right now.
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page38:1

page39.text:
I do need to be careful not to rely on it too much though.
Since I still have no idea how it works, relying on it too much risks losing it all.
So I can't rely on miracles I don't understand.
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page39:1

page40.text:
"Okay. Now there's just the rope."
I undo the rope.
My wrists were bruised, but I wasn't bound tightly enough to cut off circulation.
I don't think Illya tied me up, but I wasn't bound very tightly.
Besides, I doubt it was Illya who carried me in here anyway.
Who here, other than Illya, might not be all that strong?
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page40:1

page41.text:
"It definitely wasn't Berserker. If he'd tied me up, he'd have snapped my hands right off."
I rise to my feet as I try to crack a joke.
"...Ouch."
I can control my body, but I've pushed it too far.
While I may not be injured, magical energy is raging through my body.
Just moving around is likely to tear my insides up.
...It's probably the pain.
Dizziness and nausea wrack my entire body, and I have no feeling at the ends of my arms and legs.
I'm not going to get home before Illya gets back, not like this...
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page41:1

page42.text:
"Why am I being such a coward? I don't have time for that kind of thinking."
I slap my cheeks and start walking.
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page42:1

page43.text:
"What?"
As soon as I lean against the wall and start toward the door...
I hear something on the other side of the wall.
Footsteps.
More than one set of footsteps. People are approaching my door and talking. They stop right in front of my door.
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-02:page43:1
